evaluation_semantics.matching: Standardized concept name/SNOMED ID, matching the supplied query algorithm across context-specific node occurrences; exact stable node ID is the fallback when standardization is unavailable.
evaluation_semantics.and_or: All AND conditions and at least one OR condition per logic group; all groups must be true.
evaluation_semantics.absence: Explicit evidence only; an unmentioned fact is unknown, not absent.
evaluation_semantics.numeric: Concrete values are compared with source operators and thresholds, with LDL unit conversion when required.
evaluation_semantics.retrieval_scope: A rule branch is evaluated only when at least one standardized condition concept overlaps the case evidence.
evaluation_semantics.row: A row is fully satisfied when at least one independent nested rule branch is true.

coverage.outside_trigger_label_explanation: These can be valid because occurrence-level node IDs include source context, while the query algorithm matches equivalent standardized concepts across occurrences.
